symptoms.title: Early specks and streaks
symptoms.description: Tiny pale-yellow or reddish-brown specks usually begin on the underside of a leaf and lengthen into streaks parallel to the leaf veins.

symptoms.title: Darkening lesions
symptoms.description: The streaks enlarge and darken from brown to nearly black, becoming narrow oval or elongated spots.

symptoms.title: Gray centers and yellow halos
symptoms.description: Older lesions may develop dry light-gray centers, dark borders, and bright yellow halos.

symptoms.title: Coalescing and leaf death
symptoms.description: Numerous lesions can merge into large dead areas, reducing green leaf area and causing premature drying.

treatment.title: Use fungicides within integrated management
treatment.description: Apply appropriate fungicide treatments as part of an integrated disease-management program.

treatment.title: Avoid relying only on fungicides
treatment.description: Avoid relying exclusively on repeated fungicide applications because fungicide resistance can develop.

treatment.title: Consider complementary biological control
treatment.description: Consider biological control as a complementary management strategy where appropriate.

treatment.title: Consider resistant or tolerant cultivars
treatment.description: Consider resistant or tolerant banana cultivars as a longer-term management strategy.

treatment.title: Remove severely diseased foliage
treatment.description: Remove severely diseased leaves or affected foliage to reduce potential sources of infection.

treatment.title: Monitor disease progression
treatment.description: Regularly monitor banana leaves for the development and progression of disease symptoms.

treatment.title: Combine management approaches
treatment.description: Combine chemical, biological, cultural, and varietal approaches rather than relying on a single control method.

prevention.title: Inspect for Black Sigatoka early
prevention.description: Regularly inspect banana leaves for early signs of Black Sigatoka.

prevention.title: Remove severely diseased foliage
prevention.description: Practice field sanitation by removing severely diseased foliage.

prevention.title: Use suitable resistant planting material
prevention.description: Use resistant or tolerant planting materials when available and suitable.

prevention.title: Support healthy plant growth
prevention.description: Maintain appropriate crop-management practices that support healthy plant growth.

prevention.title: Act before disease becomes extensive
prevention.description: Monitor disease development so that management measures can be implemented before disease becomes extensive.

prevention.title: Manage fungicide resistance responsibly
prevention.description: Follow appropriate fungicide-management practices, including responsible application and rotation where applicable, to help reduce the development of fungicide resistance.
